query: Unique Automotive Repair, Inc., Tampa, FL
name: Unique Automotive Repair, Inc.
address: 1717 E Busch Blvd Ste 909, Tampa, FL 33612, United States

reviewSamples.author: Photo of John Geoghegan
reviewSamples.text: I would recommend Unique Auto and Albert to anyone looking for a comprehensive expert for their repair and upgrade needs. He completely rebuilt my 1985 Jeep CJ-7 engine as part of a restoration project and I could not be more pleased. First class service, expertise and results.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Brian Erdolino
reviewSamples.text: Albert is probably the most honest, genuine, and trustworthy mechanic I have ever dealt with. Very thorough and extremely knowledgeable. He treats his customers with respect and kindness and explains everything to the fullest and that’s before he even does the work on your vehicle. I couldn’t be happier with the results and service provided. I definitely recommend Unique Automotive Repair to anyone in the Tampa area looking for quality work.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of BBF
reviewSamples.text: Took my 2008 4-Runner in for some work and was very impressed with the quality of work, quick turnaround, and professionalism of this small repair shop. Albert is very good at what he does and runs an honest operation. I highly recommend this business.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Judd Wagner
reviewSamples.text: I had a great experience with my 2014 Jeep GC 160k miles. I had previously taken my vehicle to another mechanic for all work but just wasn’t 100% happy with the results. So I took it to Albert and from the moment speaking with him you can tell he takes great pride in his work and has an honest and solid work ethic. A small oil leak developed that I wanted resolved on the vehicle. Albert did a thorough review of my vehicle and let me know his thoughts on what the vehicle needed. I requested Albert complete the work - new valve head gaskets, new rear brakes, oxygen sensor cleaned and fixed an issue with my wiper fluid hose. Overall I could not be happier, My Jeep now runs as it did when I purchased it new. I am taking the jeep across the US about 3000 miles and need confidence it will make it there. I now have that confidence the vehicle will keep me on the road without any issues. Thank you Albert for your time and personableness throughout the interaction. I highly recommend Albert and unique automotive.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Tatiana Hurtado
reviewSamples.text:
After taking my Jeep to another mechanic twice for the same issue and still not getting answers, I was honestly getting frustrated and just wanted the problem fixed. Thankfully, I found Unique Automotive Repair through the Jeep FB group. He was able to identify the issue in less than 10 minutes of looking at my car.

Albert is extremely knowledgeable and truly an expert when it comes to cars. He took the time to explain everything to me in detail, was very honest, and immediately made me feel comfortable and confident that my Jeep was in good hands.

Now after a couple of days, my car is running great and I couldn’t be happier. It’s hard to find mechanics you can genuinely trust, but I’m so glad I found one here in the Tampa Bay area. I would absolutely recommend Unique Automotive Repair to anyone looking for honest, skilled, and reliable service.
